item.title: Angelo State Rams Sweep St. Mary’s With Extra-Inning Win
item.description: SAN ANTONIO, TX — The No. 18-ranked Angelo State University baseball team scored four runs over the final two innings to defeat No. 23 St. Mary's 5-2 in 10 innings Sunday in San Antonio, completing a four-game series sweep.The Rams improved to 14-4 and moved into a tie atop the Lone Star Conference standings. Learn More Here.

item.title: Water Valley, Veribest, Robert Lee Boys Break Through to Regional Semis
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — District 11-1A has proven to be one of the best small-school districts in the state with seven playoff trophies to its credit so far.Water Valley, Veribest and Robert Lee all won two postseason games last week, while Garden City also had a win before losing in the area round. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 1 Wall Faces Rematch With No. 6 Paradise in State Semifinals
item.description: WALL, TX — The No. 1-ranked Wall Lady Hawks have taken down No. 2 Coahoma and No. 3 Idalou in the last two rounds of the playoffs to reach the state semifinals.That doesn’t mean the path to the state championship is cleared just yet. Learn More Here.

item.title: San Angelo Man Arrested for Allegedly Beating, Kidnapping Ex-Girlfriend
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A San Angelo man has been arrested for allegedly hitting, choking and kidnapping his ex-girlfriend.Lucky James Dillon Vargas, 23, was arrested by the Tom Green County Sheriff’s Office for aggravated kidnapping with bodily injury. Learn More Here.

item.title: Texas Wins Governor’s Cup for 14th Year in a Row
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — Texas has won Site Selection magazine’s Governor’s Cup for the 14th consecutive year, Gov. Greg Abbott announced during a press conference at the Governor’s Mansion.The award recognizes the state with the most job-creating business location and expansion projects in the nation. Texas has now earned the distinction 22 times overall. Learn More Here.

item.title: Earthquake Shakes West Texas Outside Town of Stanton
item.description: STANTON, TX — A minor earthquake rattled parts of western Texas on Monday afternoon. The U.S. Geological Survey recorded a magnitude 2.4 earthquake at 1:02 p.m., centered about 8 miles west-southwest of Stanton in Martin County. The epicenter was approximately 11 miles northeast of Midland. Learn More Here.

item.title: Public Invited to First River Park Master Plan Meeting
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX - The City of San Angelo invites residents to the first of three public meetings for the River Park Master Plan from 5:30 to 8 p.m. Tuesday, March 10, in the Council Chambers at the McNease Convention Center, 501 Rio Concho Drive. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State's Garrett Baumann Named LSC's Pitcher of the Week
item.description: RICHARDSON, TX — Angelo State pitcher Garrett Baumann has been named the Lone Star Conference Pitcher of the Week after helping the No. 18 Rams complete a road sweep of No. 23 St. Mary’s, the league announced Monday.Baumann, a senior majoring in interdisciplinary studies, earned two relief victories in the four-game series. He threw eight shutout innings across Games 1 and 4, allowing three hits — all singles — while striking out six. Learn More Here.

item.title: Ag Commish Sid Miller Fears the Muslims Are Going to Kill Him
item.description: Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller issued a defiant statement on March 2, 2026, claiming he had received multiple death threats in the preceding 24 hours. He linked these threats to his outspoken criticism of what he calls the "Islamification" of Texas and the United States, as well as his strong social media responses to a recent mass shooting in Austin, which he labeled a "horrific terror attack."
